subject: Brightlane POC results — concise metrics and a quick favor
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>

Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Brightlane POC results — concise metrics and a quick favor

Hi Elena / Josh,

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month — really appreciated the partnership. I promised to send a short summary of outcomes and a small ask to help us highlight the work (nothing heavy). Attached is a one-page metrics snapshot. Quick highlights from the two-week pilot: 

- Inference latency: median 45ms (down from Brightlane baseline 180ms) when using our recommended batching/quantization profile.
- Cost per 1k tokens: estimated $2.10 (vs baseline $8.75) under observed traffic patterns.
- Successful calls per second: steady 85 rps during simulated peak, meeting your throughput target.
- Token-level error rate: 0.3% (mostly transient timeouts; we applied automatic retry policy).

Attachment: Brightlane_pilot_metrics_Q4.pdf (one page)

If these numbers look right to you, would Brightlane be open to two quick things?
1) A 1–2 sentence endorsement we can use in a short case blurb (we can propose wording), and
2) A 15–20 minute call to record a few clarifying metrics and agree on attribution (we’re flexible on timing).

Suggested one-liner (feel free to edit): “Redwood reduced inference latency and per-token cost for our production pipelines, enabling higher throughput with predictable economics.”

No pressure — totally fine if legal needs to sign off first. If you’re OK, I’ll loop in our marketing lead to coordinate the short call.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
